mapper.select: select id, yonghu_id as yonghuId, gonghao, xingming from huli_renyuan where yonghu_id = #{yonghuId} and zhuangtai != '离职' limit 1

select count(distinct rl.laoren_id) from renyuan_laoren rl join laoren_xinxi l on rl.laoren_id = l.id where rl.huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and rl.zhuangtai = '服务中' and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除'
select count(1) from huli_jilu where huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and zhuangtai != '取消' and date(huli_shijian) = curdate()
select count(1) from jiankang_jiance where huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and date(jiance_shijian) = curdate()
select count(1) from fuyao_jilu where huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and date(coalesce(shiji_shijian, jihua_shijian)) = curdate()
select count(1) from waichu_shenqing where shenqing_ren_leixing = '护理员' and shenqing_ren_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and shenpi_zhuangtai = '待审批'
select count(1) from tuizhu_shenqing where shenqing_ren_leixing = '护理员' and shenqing_ren_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and shenpi_zhuangtai = '待审批'

select distinct l.id as laorenId, l.laoren_bianhao as laorenBianhao, l.xingming as laorenXingming, l.touxiang, l.xingbie, l.nianling, l.laoren_leixing as laorenLeixing, l.ruzhu_zhuangtai as ruzhuZhuangtai, l.lianxi_dianhua as lianxiDianhua, l.jiating_zhuzhi as jiatingZhuzhi, l.beizhu, concat(coalesce(f.fangjianhao, '-'), ' / ', coalesce(c.chuangweihao, '-')) as chuangwei, hj.jibie_mingcheng as jibieMingcheng from renyuan_laoren rl join laoren_xinxi l on rl.laoren_id = l.id left join chuangwei_shiyong cs on l.id = cs.laoren_id and cs.shiyong_zhuangtai = '正在使用' left join fangjian_xinxi f on cs.fangjian_id = f.id left join chuangwei_xinxi c on cs.chuangwei_id = c.id left join laoren_huli lh on l.id = lh.laoren_id and lh.zhuangtai = '生效' left join huli_jibie hj on lh.jibie_id = hj.id where rl.huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and rl.zhuangtai = '服务中' and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除'
and l.xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
order by l.id desc

select distinct l.id as laorenId, l.laoren_bianhao as laorenBianhao, l.xingming as laorenXingming, l.touxiang, l.xingbie, l.nianling, l.laoren_leixing as laorenLeixing, l.ruzhu_zhuangtai as ruzhuZhuangtai, l.lianxi_dianhua as lianxiDianhua, l.jiating_zhuzhi as jiatingZhuzhi, l.beizhu, concat(coalesce(f.loudong, ''), coalesce(f.fangjianhao, '-'), ' / ', coalesce(c.chuangweihao, '-')) as chuangwei, hj.jibie_mingcheng as jibieMingcheng from renyuan_laoren rl join laoren_xinxi l on rl.laoren_id = l.id left join chuangwei_shiyong cs on l.id = cs.laoren_id and cs.shiyong_zhuangtai = '正在使用' left join fangjian_xinxi f on cs.fangjian_id = f.id left join chuangwei_xinxi c on cs.chuangwei_id = c.id left join laoren_huli lh on l.id = lh.laoren_id and lh.zhuangtai = '生效' left join huli_jibie hj on lh.jibie_id = hj.id where rl.huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and rl.laoren_id = #{laorenId} and rl.zhuangtai = '服务中' and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' limit 1

select x.id, x.xiangmu_bianhao as xiangmuBianhao, x.xiangmu_mingcheng as xiangmuMingcheng, x.jiage, x.zhixing_zhouqi as zhixingZhouqi, x.zhixing_cishu as zhixingCishu, x.danwei from laoren_huli lh join jibie_xiangmu jx on lh.jibie_id = jx.jibie_id join huli_xiangmu x on jx.xiangmu_id = x.id join renyuan_laoren rl on lh.laoren_id = rl.laoren_id where lh.laoren_id = #{laorenId} and lh.zhuangtai = '生效' and x.zhuangtai = '启用' and rl.huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and rl.zhuangtai = '服务中' order by x.id desc

select count(1) from laoren_huli lh join jibie_xiangmu jx on lh.jibie_id = jx.jibie_id join huli_xiangmu x on jx.xiangmu_id = x.id join renyuan_laoren rl on lh.laoren_id = rl.laoren_id where lh.laoren_id = #{laorenId} and jx.xiangmu_id = #{xiangmuId} and lh.zhuangtai = '生效' and x.zhuangtai = '启用' and rl.huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and rl.zhuangtai = '服务中'
mapper.insert: insert into huli_jilu ( laoren_id, huli_renyuan_id, xiangmu_id, huli_shijian, huli_shuliang, huli_neirong, laoren_fankui, zhuangtai ) values ( #{laorenId}, #{huliRenyuanId}, #{xiangmuId}, coalesce(#{huliShijian}, now()), coalesce(#{huliShuliang}, 1), #{huliNeirong}, #{laorenFankui}, coalesce(#{zhuangtai}, '已完成') )
mapper.select: select yj.id, yj.laoren_id as laorenId, yj.yaopin_id as yaopinId from yongyao_jihua yj join renyuan_laoren rl on yj.laoren_id = rl.laoren_id where yj.id = #{jihuaId} and rl.huli_renyuan_id = #{huliRenyuanId} and rl.zhuangtai = '服务中' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into waichu_shenqing ( laoren_id, huli_renyuan_id, waichu_shiyou, waichu_shijian, yuji_huiyuan_shijian, peitong_ren, peitong_dianhua, shenqing_ren_id, shenqing_ren_leixing, shenqing_ren_xingming, shenpi_zhuangtai ) values ( #{laorenId}, #{huliRenyuanId}, #{waichuShiyou}, coalesce(#{waichuShijian}, now()), #{yujiHuiyuanShijian}, #{peitongRen}, #{peitongDianhua}, #{shenqingRenId}, #{shenqingRenLeixing}, #{shenqingRenXingming}, '待审批' )

insert into tuizhu_shenqing ( laoren_id, huli_renyuan_id, tuizhu_leixing, tuizhu_yuanyin, tuizhu_shijian, shenqing_ren_id, shenqing_ren_leixing, shenqing_ren_xingming, shenpi_zhuangtai ) values ( #{laorenId}, #{huliRenyuanId}, coalesce(#{tuizhuLeixing}, '正常退住'), #{tuizhuYuanyin}, #{tuizhuShijian}, #{shenqingRenId}, #{shenqingRenLeixing}, #{shenqingRenXingming}, '待审批' )
